narrative.verdict: Markets look calm. Nothing here suggests unusual risk this week.
narrative.means_for_you: A normal week — a good time to ignore the noise and stick to your plan.

reality_check.line: Headlines sound worried, but the market signals are calm — likely media noise so far.

narrative.nudge: In the 18 most similar past setups, sharp drops were uncommon and the market was higher a month later 72% of the time. Reacting impulsively to weeks like this has usually cost more than it saved.
